decisions.reason: Correctly locates the apiProxy injection, the dot-domain llm.providers call and the dead @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy dependency with valid citations, but never identifies card A1-01 by name and does not explain the llm.providers split into listProviders/listConfigurableProviders or that the dependency package is removed in the target version, leaving the card mapping generic.

Each of the six non-apiProxy categories has an explicit no-hit conclusion backed by scanned-file evidence; session-notes.js is shown to be pure string/array helpers with citations, and cordis.patch.yml is treated as ordinary plugin composition without claiming a host-source patch.

Explicitly answers that zero hits do not establish compatibility, citing scan-coverage limits (dynamic/indirect access false negatives), dependency resolution, patch semantics and runtime behavior as needing separate evidence, while keeping the decisive apiProxy hit distinct from the six negative categories.

Specifies post-migration build/typecheck, an isolated 0.1.2-alpha.2 cold boot, and a functional smoke test of the provider call path, correctly framed as proposed checks rather than ones executed against the non-runnable fixture.
